items.title: Deal to end fighting would lead to Hormuz reopening, Iran says
items.description: The deal which will pave the way for hostilities to end is close to being finalised, the US, Iran and mediators Pakistan say.

items.title: Elon Musk becomes world's first trillionaire as SpaceX soars in stock market debut
items.description: Musk is now worth $1.11tn according to the Bloomberg rich list, while SpaceX listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange with a value of $2.2tn.

items.title: French town buries murdered child as questions mount over police failings
items.description: The prime suspect in the killing of Lyhanna, 11, was reported to police nine months prior but never questioned.

items.title: Discovery of €1.2m jewellery prompts fresh probe into former Spanish PM
items.description: José Luis Rodriguez Zapatero is suspected of being unable to show proof he paid import duties on the jewellery.

items.title: Fans on concourses instead of in seats, claims Fifa
items.description: Fifa says numerous empty seats were visible in the near-sell-out Group A match between South Korea and the Czech Republic because of fans remaining on concourses.

items.title: Taylor Swift makes tearful 21-minute speech as she joins Songwriters Hall of Fame
items.description: The singer thanks her family as she becomes the youngest woman to be inducted into the Hall of Fame.

items.title: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha dies after more than three years in coma
items.description: Princess Bajrakitiyabha, the king's eldest daughter, collapsed in December 2022 while exercising her dogs.

items.title: More time needed for deadly Air India crash inquiry, officials say
items.description: A statement says "significant progress" has been made into investigating the crash, in which 260 people died a year ago.

items.title: Mother finds body of missing son two days after Kenya's Ebola quarantine centre protests
items.description: Sylvester Muigai Ndung'u was in Nanyuki to fetch a school uniform on Tuesday, his mother says.

items.title: 'They destroyed the future': Palestinian anger at rise in Israeli demolitions in East Jerusalem
items.description: Palestinian homes are being pulled down in occupied East Jerusalem to make way for a park.

items.title: King leads tributes to 'giant of the art world' David Hockney
items.description: The artist, who has died at the age of 88, "was one of life's true originals", King Charles says.

items.title: South Africa trolled by African fans in wake of World Cup loss
items.description: The taunting reflects anger from parts of the continent over reports of xenophobia in South Africa.
